content:
The **Charleston Landfill** is a location in The Forest region of Appalachia. It is a Public Workshop with claim and defend event quests.

This vast junkyard on the western outskirts of Charleston was once the central dump for the city.

The area has many junk piles that can be harvested either by hand or using a Junk Extractor. An industrial Water Purifier sits in a small pool of Dirty Water among the junk piles, near a Cooking Station and a pile of Skeletons.

The Workshop workbench is located near two hollowed-out trailers on the western edge of the location. Both trailers contain some generic junk.

The center contains a Cooking Station and lots of Skeletons in the nearby fireplace, a Water Purifier that only requires power once the Workshop is claimed, and plenty of resources to exploit.

Available resources include food (6), water (8), junk (3), Aluminum (1), Copper (1), and Steel (1).

Aluminum, Copper, junk, and Steel deposits can be found near the claimable Workshop here.

The Charleston Landfill appears in *Fallout 76*.
